s1.desc: a cosy bedroom with a yellow wooden bed, duck-shaped bedposts and peach lamps on two nightstands

spans.notes: slow push-in over the whole shot (ORB on the lamp/nightstand: scale 1.000 -> 1.033, drift up-left, motion from ~f2 to f42). Pax reads, Polly dozes.

Polly close-up: slow push-in easing out (ORB on the bedpost: scale 1.000 -> 1.012; background frame diff 1.3 -> 0.03 at f65, 0.02 at f66, exactly 0.00 from f67). Re-checked after the lead's push-in correction: the kept span now starts at f67, the first frame with zero background change.

spans.view: with a duck-shaped bedpost and the headboard behind her

beats.text: Polly lies tucked under the blanket and gazes up to the left with a worried brow, her beak moving as she speaks

spans.notes: camera locked from f67 (bedpost ROI frame diff 0.00, ORB scale constant; compare 65/97 bedpost and headboard black). Pax is only the corner of his book and a sliver of fin at the left edge, so he is not listed.

spans.view: with a duck-shaped bedpost and a peach lamp behind him

beats.text: Pax sits up in bed holding an open teal book and turns a page with his fin
Pax reads on, his beak moving as he reads the page aloud
Pax blinks slowly over the book, then looks down at the page again
Pax turns his head to the right and looks over with raised brows, still holding the book

spans.notes: camera locked (ORB on the bedpost/lamp: scale 1.0000, 0 px over the whole shot; compare 98/168 background black).
Polly pleading close-up with a push-in through the whole shot (scale 1.000 -> 1.048, drift up-left; background diff 0.5-2.3 every frame).

spans.view: with the big bed seen from above at an angle, nightstands with lamps on both sides

beats.text: Pax reads his book with half-closed eyes while Polly lies beside him smiling up at him with rosy cheeks
Pax shuts the book with his eyes closed and a small smile while Polly watches
Pax turns and sets the closed book down on the nightstand to the left
Pax pushes back the blanket, sits on the edge of the bed and hops down to the floor
Pax waddles away to the lower left and out of view while Polly stays on her pillow
Polly, alone in bed, stretches both fins up and wiggles happily under the blanket

spans.notes: camera locked (ORB on the left nightstand: scale 1.000, 0 px across f211-325; compare 211/325 bed black). Pax's last sliver leaves the left edge at f304.
